entries.failure: Expected-empty memory-registry search surfaced ripgrep exit 1 as a wrapper failure.
entries.recovery: Normalize only the expected no-match exit code and retain zero memory-content use.

entries.failure: A combined source and owned-lane Git preflight exceeded its wrapper with no attributable result.
entries.recovery: Split the probe into bounded no-profile source and owned-lane checks.

entries.failure: A PowerShell foreach statement was piped directly and failed parsing before file reads.
entries.recovery: Collect results in an explicit array before ConvertTo-Json.

entries.failure: A historical-manifest audit first modeled the advanced checkout and phase-only tree as immutable commit truth.
entries.recovery: Read manifests from exact commit blobs and use whole-commit delta scope where declared.

entries.failure: A compressed manifest diagnostic had an unmatched brace and stopped at parse time.
entries.recovery: Use a structured multiline bounded probe with balanced blocks.

entries.failure: A JavaScript template delimiter collided with an embedded PowerShell escape.
entries.recovery: Build commands from plain line arrays without embedded delimiter escapes.

entries.failure: A guessed source proposal-ledger path was absent and nonterminating PowerShell produced null-derived mirrors.
entries.recovery: Discover exact paths first and use terminating reads.

entries.failure: AGENTS.md discovery returned the expected ripgrep no-match exit and the wrapper surfaced it as failure.
entries.recovery: Normalize only exit 1 after preserving the failed witness.

entries.failure: A Windows literal wildcard path was passed to ripgrep and failed with invalid path syntax.
entries.recovery: Use a directory root plus ripgrep -g filtering.

entries.failure: The first x1 test assumed nonexistent failed_witnesses and passing_witnesses count keys.
entries.recovery: Inspect the exact ledger schema and assert counts.witness_results.fail and counts.witness_results.pass.

entries.failure: The first x1 rebuild assumed Method Flow init would overwrite an existing append-only ledger.
entries.recovery: Preserve the ledger, inspect existing method IDs, and append only missing records and witnesses.
